title: Pointwise example budget bound
statement: For all $n,k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, the total random-example budget with dyadic failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}$ is at most $T_k A_k(n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+3}(b+1)$, where $T_k$ is the junta-tree call count and $A_k$ is the specified natural-number linear-confidence coefficient.
